badge_title: Indonesian Capital Market Financial Research Assistant
hero_title: Fundamental research on IDX stocks, in seconds
hero_desc: Ask in plain language. SynthEX pulls live financials, benchmarks peers across the sector, and assembles the valuation matrix — so your time goes into deciding, not digging through reports.
preview_question: How has BBCA's profit growth and leverage trended over the last 3 years?
preview_answer: Net profit compounded at 12.4% per year while debt-to-equity sat at 0.11x — well under the sector median of 0.68x. Margins widened 180 bps across the period.
preview_disclaimer: Interface preview. Figures are illustrative, not live market data.
problem_title: Three things that used to eat your afternoon
problem_1_title: Read the report, not all 80 pages
problem_1_desc: Financial statements arrive as PDFs and portal exports. Copilot reads the structured data behind them and answers the exact question you asked — revenue trend, margin, leverage.
problem_2_title: Compare a whole sector in one view
problem_2_desc: Pull PER, PBV, ROE, and dividend yield for every major name in a sub-sector, then see immediately who sits above and below the median.
problem_3_title: Describe the screen, don't configure it
problem_3_desc: "Consumer stocks with high dividend yield and low debt" is the entire configuration. The screener translates your criteria into ranked matches.
features_title: Built for how fundamental work actually happens
feature_1_desc: Every answer is grounded in a tool call against live market data — and you can see each step, the endpoint it reached, and the payload it returned. No black box.
feature_1_point_2: Failed calls surface loudly, never silently
feature_1_example: Example: "How has BBCA's profit growth and leverage trended over the last 3 years?"
feature_2_desc: Benchmark a company against its sub-sector across the ratios that matter, with the sector median rendered alongside so every number has context.
feature_2_point_1: PER, PBV, ROE and dividend yield
feature_2_example: Example: "Compare valuations among major banks: BBCA, BBRI, BMRI, and BBNI."
feature_3_desc: Screen stocks against your own criteria without building technical filters. The system returns the top matches ranked against the metrics you named.
feature_3_point_2: Ranked matches, not a raw dump
feature_3_example: Example: "Find consumer goods stocks with high dividend yields and low debt."
workspace_title: Manage all research in one unified dashboard
workspace_1_desc: Keep a watchlist of candidates and your private analytical history in your own account, retrievable at any time.
workspace_2_desc: Track sector movement and actively traded tickers to get macro context before you commit to a decision.
insights_desc: Short research notes published to the public desk — readable without an account.
faq_1_a: No. SynthEX is a research tool. Every output carries a compliance disclaimer and is meant to speed up analysis you would otherwise do yourself — not to replace your own judgement.
faq_2_q: Where does the market data come from?
faq_2_a: Market data is served from the Sectors API and cached per endpoint, so repeating a question does not consume additional quota. Editorial articles are written by our analyst desk.
faq_3_a: Yes. Both the interface and the copilot handle Indonesian and English. Switch languages from the top bar at any time.
faq_4_q: Do I need to know accounting?
faq_4_a: No. Ratios come back already contextualised against the sub-sector median, so a PER of 9.6x is shown next to the peers it should be compared against.
final_desc: No card, no setup. Ask about any listed company and see the working behind the answer.
final_fine: Free account · Indonesian & English · Compliance disclaimer on every answer
footer_disclaimer: SynthEX is a financial research tool, not an investment advisor. Nothing on this page constitutes a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Market data is provided by a third-party API and may be delayed or incomplete. Always do your own due diligence.
